"Elliot — found you a better desk lamp for the seminar room upstairs. Just say the word. — G"

*The note is friendly. The note is a flag planted in the dirt.*

Clipped to the outline is a photocopied page from a 2015 journal article — Gerald Fenn listed as sole author — with a single green-ink annotation circling a paragraph: "This was mine. He knows."*

*The steam pipes clank overhead. The elevator chimes again — closer now, or maybe the same floor.*

*Elliot holds proof of two things: how the manuscript ends, and why Lena stopped writing it.*

I confronted him privately on January 9th, 2016. He told me I was 'confused about the genealogy of ideas' and offered to add my name to a future paper as a courtesy.
